resolvedFindings.finding: Runtime option DTO omitted the parent relationship required to build a cascade tree.
resolvedFindings.resolution: ReferenceOption and schema mapping now expose parentValue from the published snapshot.

resolvedFindings.finding: Cascader, Rate and Slider tags rendered as unresolved components.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The Ant Design Vue components are registered centrally and verified in desktop/mobile screenshots.

resolvedFindings.finding: The edit form briefly accepted input before the requested active record finished loading, allowing a new draft to be created.
resolvedFindings.resolution: formReady gates controls and actions until the route record and loaded aggregate match.

resolvedFindings.finding: Enter inside the TAG selector could submit the outer form while adding a tag.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The form prevents implicit submit after the tag selector handles Enter; both tags persist through edit and refresh.

resolvedFindings.finding: Configuration selects lacked explicit accessible labels and the shared modal showed an English Cancel button.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Index/currency controls have aria labels and the shared modal uses Chinese confirm/cancel labels.
